A newly established state-of-the-art Private Not for Profit (PNFP) teaching and research hospital in Jinja City, founded by the Trustees of the Catholic Diocese of Jinja under the Ecclesiastical Province of Tororo Archdiocese — offering clinical excellence with a Christ-centered, compassionate touch.

**Job Title: Medical Officer (3 Positions)**

**Department:** Medical | **Reports to:** Medical Superintendent

**Main Purpose of the Job:**
To manage the delivery of efficient and effective curative and preventive health services within the hospital and surrounding areas.

**Key Results Areas:**
- Conducting examinations of patients in hospital wards or outpatient clinics.
- Performing medical procedures.
- Documenting reports and maintaining patient records.
- Addressing patient concerns and answering questions about their health.
- Offering guidance on proper nutrition and hygiene.
- Participating in staff meetings and conferences.
- Responding to emergency cases.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**
- **Patient Assessment:** Gathering thorough medical histories, performing physical examinations, and evaluating test results to identify and diagnose health conditions.

- **Data Management:** Gathering, organizing, and assessing health data to ensure efficient information use and reporting.
- **Treatment Planning:** Advising on, creating, and executing treatment strategies, which may involve prescribing medications, therapy, or undertaking surgical interventions.
- **Collaboration:** Cooperating with nurses, specialists, and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive patient care; attending multidisciplinary team meetings.
- **Supervision:** Overseeing and mentoring junior medical staff and other team members.
- **Patient Communication:** Effectively conveying medical information, treatment alternatives, possible side effects, and preventive health practices to patients and their families.
- **Continuing Education:** Remaining updated with medical innovations, best practices, and industry developments through ongoing learning and training.
- **Hygiene and Safety:** Implementing and ensuring adherence to general hygiene protocols, universal precautions, and infection control measures.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

2. Must be registered with the UMDPC and hold a valid practicing license.

**Department:** Medical/Maternity | **Reports to:** Director of Nursing

**Main Purpose of the Job:**
To provide comprehensive promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative maternal and child health services. The role focuses on safe pregnancy, independent conduct of normal deliveries, prompt identification and referral of obstetric complications, and newborn care in line with national health standards.

**Key Outputs:**
- Safe deliveries conducted with minimal maternal and neonatal morbidity or mortality.
- Expectant and nursing mothers received, examined, registered, and appropriately admitted or discharged.
- High-risk pregnancies and obstetric emergencies identified and promptly managed or referred.
- Accurate and confidential clinical records, partographs, registers, and Health Management Information System (HMIS) reports maintained.

- Clean, safe, and orderly maternity ward environment maintained adhering to infection prevention standards.

- **Intrapartum Care:** Monitoring active labor using a partograph, conducting clean and safe normal deliveries, and assisting medical officers during complicated deliveries.
- **Emergency Obstetric Care:** Recognizing and managing immediate emergency complications such as postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) or eclampsia, stabilizing patients, and arranging timely emergency referrals.
- **Newborn Care:** Performing immediate newborn evaluations, drying and warming babies, initiating newborn resuscitation when required, and properly labeling newborns.
- **Postnatal Care & Counselling:** Providing postpartum checks for mothers and babies, promoting early exclusive breastfeeding, and administering scheduled infant immunizations.
- **Record Keeping & Reporting:** Documenting clinical findings on patient charts, filling out birth notifications, and compiling daily or monthly ward activity reports.

description:
**Job Opportunity — Uganda Martyrs' Hospital (UMH), Diocese of Jinja**

A newly established state-of-the-art Private Not for Profit (PNFP) teaching and research hospital in Jinja City, founded by the Catholic Diocese of Jinja — healing body, mind, and spirit.

**Job Title: Counselor / Customer Care Expert (1 Position)**

**Department:** Medical/Patient Support

**Main Purpose of the Job:**
To provide professional counseling and psychosocial support to patients and their families, and champion patient-centered, compassionate care across the hospital in line with its Christ-centered mission.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Provide individual and group counseling to patients facing illness, grief, trauma, chronic disease, and other life challenges.
- Conduct pre- and post-test counseling for conditions requiring it (e.g., HIV, chronic illnesses).
- Support patients and families in coping with diagnoses, treatment plans, and difficult decisions.
- Identify patients with psychosocial risks and refer complex cases to appropriate specialists or services.
- Champion customer care standards: receive and attend to patients courteously, address concerns, and gather feedback for service improvement.
- Facilitate patient support groups and health education talks.
- Maintain strict confidentiality and professional ethics in all client interactions.
- Keep accurate, confidential counseling records and submit periodic reports.
- Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings and continuous professional development.

**Qualifications:**
- Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Counseling Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Social Work, or a closely related field from a recognized institution.

**Competencies:**
- Empathy, active listening, and strong interpersonal skills.
- High integrity, discretion, and ability to handle confidential matters.
- Good communication and customer care skills.
how_to_apply:
Submit an application letter and detailed CV including contact details of 3 professional referees, plus certified copies of academic documents, physically or via email to: The Diocesan Coordinator of Health Services Department, Health Office - Diocese of Jinja, opposite Jinja College, Rubaga Hill, P.O. Box 673, Jinja. Email: dhcjinja@ucmb.co.ug

Deadline: 4th September 2026 at 5:00 PM. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Successful candidates will undergo reference checks and safeguarding screening per Diocesan recruitment policies.
